card.name: Resource and time-span wording
card.fires_on: Words that stand for a share, span or amount of time or resources, such as 'resources', 'to' in day ranges, 'of' after a percent, and the 4 in '/24 hours'. It also fires on pieces of 'remaining' and 'somnolence'.

modes.label: Resources and time shares
modes.description: Nouns or linking words about resources, time or portions of a project.
modes.example: might deflect<< resources>> and attention from proven technologies

modes.label: Day and hour spans
modes.description: Parts of dosing ranges and per-24-hour rates in label text.

modes.label: Partway through words
modes.description: Inside words like remaining or somnolence.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of allocate-type words, so it likely steers away from 'allocated' and similar wording.
card.plain: It marks words about amounts, spans of time or resources, mostly in dosing schedules, and has a loose link to the word 'allocated'.
